Hc.bar_b_note: The plated boar's naturalistic fur and plates reach toward the owner bar, but the floating faint-mid pose and the faint-end body crushing to black (worst on A) sink it below a shipping finish.

Rn.bar_b_note: The old villager's appealing stylised face, white hair and olive/brown outfit carry a Palworld-class character finish that fits the key-art village.

Bs.bar_b_note: A flat-lit face with small dull eyes and an all-black outfit with no oxblood faction mark reads as a low-finish placeholder next to the other characters and the Palworld cast.

Dh.bar_b_note: Smeared ground textures, a uniform grass carpet, a muddy tunnel wall and flat noon light with no haze or depth grade sink it, although B's site-specific aftermaths (freed captive, smoke, fallen banners) help.

Uu.bar_b_note: Same appealing, well-shaded villager as Rn: readable face and eyes and a natural palette that sits in the key-art world.

Sb.bar_b_note: B's timber frame, cap and stone footing help, but a flat untextured infill on a thin standalone panel beside a faceted placeholder boulder in a blurry grass field is far from Palworld base-building finish.

top_changes.change: Meadows ground pass: sharper terrain/grass materials, break the uniform grass carpet into groves, edges and dirt clearings, and add a warm sun grade with cool blue distance haze (helps Dh, Sb and every world frame)
Give the homestead wall a real thick infill (planks or wattle-and-daub with value variation and depth) instead of a flat pale card, and replace the faceted placeholder boulder beside it

Bring the Team Tether member up to the villager's finish: shaded face, larger readable eyes, and an oxblood faction mark on the black outfit; and in every defeat aftermath remove or topple the oxblood banners
